summary.name: WeChat (Mac)
summary.one_liner: WeChat is the desktop Mac version of Tencent's free messaging and calling app, listed on the Mac App Store.
use_cases: Making two-person voice or video calls on desktop
Reading Official Accounts articles on a computer
Staying in touch with WeChat users from a desktop
summary.what_it_does: The page describes WeChat as the free messaging and calling app, now available for desktop on Mac. Listed features include inviting others to join a two-person voice or video call and asking AI about files and Official Accounts articles. The app is published by Tencent Mobile International Limited, is listed under Social Networking, and is 489 MB. It requires macOS 12.0 or later and supports English, Simplified Chinese and Traditional Chinese. The developer's privacy section lists data that may be linked to the user, including location, user content, identifiers, usage data and diagnostics.
notable: Desktop version of the WeChat messaging app for Mac
AI can answer questions about files and Official Accounts articles
Available in English, Simplified Chinese and Traditional Chinese
caveats: Developer privacy section lists data that may be linked to the user's identity
Not enough ratings or reviews to show an overview
Developer has not indicated accessibility feature support
